description: Return one customer account: its traits and billing, activity for a period, the identified users active in it, its health and the account reviewer's last review. Keys come from list_accounts.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: get_account

outputSchema.description: account is null when the key has no traits and no activity in the period. traits holds every trait sent with group(). members lists up to 50 identified users active in the account, most recent first, with profile_id usable as a get_data profile filter; moreMembers says others were active too, which get_data group_members with this account's filters pages through. health is last night's stage, kind, attention, churn risk and signals, with act: whether to act on it now, soon or not at all (null), paying: whether it pays, by its billing or by a member's payment in the last weeks where the website sends no billing, and payments: what its members paid in the last 90 days by the connected payment provider (null when none did); review is the account reviewer's last reading, with what they use the product for; both are null until the account is judged. usageFilter is the get_data filter that scopes queries such as top_pages and custom_events to this account.

title: Get account
